b5b151999e75.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, AI Productivity
b5b151999e75.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart's AI Productivity team builds the AI-powered platforms and tools that help our engineers and the broader R&D organization move faster, reduce toil, and deliver higher-quality experiences for customers, shoppers, retailers, and brand partners. We have been at the forefront of applied AI for years, and we move quickly: we prototype, ship, learn, and retire what is no longer the best answer.

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will set the direction for how AI changes the way Instacart builds products and software, and you will drive that change across the whole company. You will stay close to where the AI industry is heading, anticipate where the industry and Instacart will be 18 to 36 months from now, and turn that view into strategy, pilots, and adoption at scale. That means more work handled in the background by orchestrated, cost-efficient, and compliant agents, so people can focus on the work that needs human judgment.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role. You will write code, partner with senior engineering and finance leadership, evaluate vendors and prototypes, and lead organizational change, including the cultural and people side of adoption. This position is remote-friendly within North America.

 

About the Job

  • Define and drive the company-wide strategy for AI-assisted software and product development, anticipating where the industry and Instacart are headed over the next 18 to 36 months.</

5bcc4e7935b9.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

Twitch is all about community, and our Community team is a core pillar of what makes Twitch, Twitch. Community Discovery & ML (CDML) helps millions of viewers find the creators and communities they'll love. That covers search, browse, the mobile live and clips feeds, recommended notifications, and the recommendation systems behind them. When a viewer finds a new creator through one of these, it's often the start of a lasting connection. That connection is what keeps viewers, and the creators they watch, coming back.

About the Role

We're looking for a data scientist with strong statistics and modeling skills to be the science partner for the machine learning and recommendation systems behind Twitch's discovery products. You will work with product managers, ML engineers and applied scientists to help build what our recommendation systems should optimize for. That means balancing what a viewer does today (a click, a play, minutes watched) against what keeps them coming back: return visits, daily habits, and lasting connections with creators. It also means weighing short-form clips against long-form live content, and each surface against the others. This role will draw from a variety of statistical learning techniques, causal inference, optimization and recommender systems evaluation, and it still owns the full path from question to decision.

Reporting to the Director of Data Science, you will work from our San Francisco, CA office.

d6694422a5b5.title: Senior Autonomy Software Engineer
d6694422a5b5.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Autonomy Software Engineer is a key, hands-on role. You will build the on-robot autonomy that lets Apollo complete full shifts of real work at customer sites. You will build the mission and behavior framework that turns a job from fleet software into robot actions. You will also build the runtime that runs learned policies safely on the robot, together with navigation, perception, and control. The main focus of this role is to move learned behaviors, including learned and language-conditioned navigation, from simulation to reliable use on physical robots. As a senior member of the team, you will also mentor engineers and raise the team's engineering standards.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Design, build, and own the on-robot mission and behavior framework. This framework coordinates navigation, perception, manipulation, and control to complete customer missions.
  • Integrate learned policies on the robot: imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and large multimodal robot models. Make sure that on-device inference meets real-time latency and compute budgets.
  • Develop supervisors, safety wrappers, and fallback behaviors for learned autonomy. Work with the safety team to keep learned behaviors within safe limits near people.
  • Build failure detection and recovery. The robot must retry, re-plan, or resume a mission at the failed step before it asks a person for help.
  • Extend the autonomy stack to learned navigation, including language-conditioned navigation policies. Keep the classical planner as the safe fallback.
  • Build tools for telemetry, logging, replay, and evaluation. Run regression tests in simulation (for example Isaac Sim) and on hardware to measure and improve mission success and intervention rates.
  • Work closely with the navigation, perception, controls, reinforcement learning, and platform teams. Define clear interfaces, and find the root cause of system-level problems on physical robots.
  • Mentor engineers through technical guidance, design reviews, and code reviews. Improve code quality, testing, and CI/CD practices.

At SK hynix America, we are at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. SK hynix US AI DC Solutions is building and operating a 1~5 MW class AI Data Center testbed with LLM serving as the primary target workload. cb5050611da7.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.  

We’re here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

You will work across these surfaces to deliver an exceptional experience that serves insurance payors, licensing partners, syndicators, and AI labs.

We are looking for a versatile full-stack engineer who is excited about building rich frontend experiences that partners can quickly drop into their own apps. Think embeddable scheduling components that range from lightweight to fully featured, as well as our Partner Portal where customers may manage their accounts, view analytics, and try new features. You'll help deliver these products and lead where they go next, using AI to ship quality software quickly and help the whole team move more nimbly!
